incidents.detail: Initial implementation was pushed to main before the single PR was opened. History is preserved; all subsequent correction is in the single PR.
GitHub rejected runner.temp in job-level env before job execution; corrected by step-level GITHUB_ENV binding.
Actions compiler caught a selector assignment using :=, a missing generated package import, an unused CLI import, and generator formatting drift; corrected in the same PR.

notes: GitHub Actions is the validation authority.
No other Gooo repository or gooo-self-improvement-ledger is modified.
